tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The room. hsl(222 28% 5%): near-black with a navy tint, so the haze has something to glow into. Every slide sits on this; light and glass are layered over it, never another fill.

tokens.name: light
tokens.usage: Neutral light. The colour of the haze and card glow on slides that belong to neither runner. Never text, never a fill.

tokens.name: light-haze
tokens.usage: Ambient light source on neutral slides: a large radial gradient from a corner, fading to transparent at 70%.

tokens.name: light-glow
tokens.usage: Corner glow inside a glass card on a neutral slide.

tokens.name: glass-fill
tokens.usage: Card fill. Translucent white over the haze, so a card picks up the light behind it.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: 1px card border. The hairline that makes glass read as an object.

tokens.name: glass-highlight
tokens.usage: 1px inset top highlight (see shadow glass-inset): light catching the card's top edge.

tokens.name: text-1
tokens.usage: Numbers, titles, names. At least 12.9:1 measured on the brightest glass behind it. Every number on the dashboard is this colour, whoever it belongs to.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Units, labels, captions. At least 7.3:1 measured on glass. Lifted from the v1 grey because glass and haze raise the background behind labels from about #14 to #36.

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Walk-closer only: status, secondary caption. At least 4.5:1 on glass. Never anything the sofa needs.

tokens.name: mark-unlit
tokens.usage: Every mark that is not 'now': goal-bar tracks, past weeks' bars, unlit dots. 1.67:1 against the card: visible as shape, silent as signal.

tokens.name: mark-lit
tokens.usage: The one lit mark on a neutral slide. On a runner's slide the lit mark is that runner's colour instead.

tokens.name: runner-a
tokens.usage: Jeffrey. Lives in LIGHT (haze, card glow) and MARKS (bars, ring, progress, his dot) only; never text. 4.82:1 lit mark against an unlit track.

tokens.name: runner-b
tokens.usage: Eugenia. Same rules as runner-a. Lifted from #5c8dff, which failed 3:1 as a lit bar on its track; now 3.32:1. Jeffrey vs Eugenia: CIEDE2000 48 normal, 56 deuteranopia, 52 protanopia.

tokens.name: runner-a-haze
tokens.usage: Jeffrey's light source. Head-to-head: top-left of the room. Solo: the whole room takes it.

tokens.name: runner-b-haze
tokens.usage: Eugenia's light source. Head-to-head: bottom-right of the room.

tokens.name: runner-a-glow
tokens.usage: Corner glow inside Jeffrey's card, from its outer (top-left) corner.

tokens.name: runner-a-edge
tokens.usage: Jeffrey's card's 2px lit edge at its outer corner, fading to 0.12 along the card.

tokens.name: runner-a-halo
tokens.usage: Light spilling round Jeffrey's card, toward his corner.

tokens.name: runner-b-glow
tokens.usage: Corner glow inside Eugenia's card, from its outer (bottom-right) corner.

tokens.name: runner-b-edge
tokens.usage: Eugenia's card's 2px lit edge at its outer corner, fading to 0.12 along the card.

tokens.name: runner-b-halo
tokens.usage: Light spilling round Eugenia's card, toward her corner.

tokens.name: runner-card-dim
tokens.usage: Smoked-glass ground under a runner card's fill, so the stronger haze shows round the card, not behind its captions.

tokens.name: intensity-a-1
tokens.usage: Jeffrey ramp, 40% toward ground. Presence, not value: 2.3:1, so nothing that must be read may use it. Carried over from v1's rule; not yet re-checked on glass.

tokens.name: intensity-a-2
tokens.usage: Jeffrey ramp, 55%.

tokens.name: intensity-a-3
tokens.usage: Jeffrey ramp, 70%.

tokens.name: intensity-a-4
tokens.usage: Jeffrey ramp, 85%.

tokens.name: intensity-a-5
tokens.usage: Jeffrey ramp, full value.

tokens.name: intensity-b-1
tokens.usage: Eugenia ramp, 40% toward ground. Same rule as the Jeffrey ramp.

tokens.name: intensity-b-2
tokens.usage: Eugenia ramp, 55%.

tokens.name: intensity-b-3
tokens.usage: Eugenia ramp, 70%.

tokens.name: intensity-b-4
tokens.usage: Eugenia ramp, 85%.

tokens.name: intensity-b-5
tokens.usage: Eugenia ramp, full value.

tokens.name: cross
tokens.usage: Strength hours. Warm neutral, kept from v1: 32 dE from Eugenia's blue in every vision type, but only 19–24 from Jeffrey's orange, so on his slides tell it apart by lightness or position, not hue alone. Not yet re-checked on glass.

tokens.name: cross-dim
tokens.usage: Other cross-training. Told apart from cross by lightness (2.6:1), never by hue.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Genuine extremes only (stale sync, demo data), and only as a chip carrying a glyph and a word in text-1. Never a data series: under deuteranopia it is 12 dE from Jeffrey's orange.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: 34.5 arcmin digit height at 2.25 m; readable to 4.9 m. The one number on a solo slide. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: stat-xl
styles.usage: 26.5 arcmin; readable to 3.7 m. Two numbers, head-to-head. Fits the widest distance (88.8 km) with 7px to spare in a head-to-head card. Pace on head-to-head: move /km into the caption.

styles.name: stat-lg
styles.usage: 21.2 arcmin, just above the 20 arcmin comfortable floor; readable to 3.0 m. Up to four numbers per slide.

styles.name: stat-md
styles.usage: 17.3 arcmin: above the 16 minimum, below comfortable. Last resort; prefer splitting the slide.

styles.name: unit
styles.usage: Beside its number, top-aligned, 10px gap, in text-2. At 64px the head-to-head numbers overflow their cards.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: UPPERCASE runner and stat names. 8.4 arcmin capital height: recognised by shape once the slide is learned. The slide must still work if it is a smudge.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Slide title, in the 48px header. Orients someone at the screen, not on the sofa.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Context under a number, text-2 or text-3. The point of a slide never lives here.

styles.name: axis
styles.usage: Chart ticks; about six per axis, not twelve.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Status and the page counter (Outfit tabular numerals; no monospace face is shipped). text-3.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Slide edge to content, left and right; also header padding.

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: Header band: page counter, title, status.

tokens.name: rule-h
tokens.usage: Progress rule under the header, filling over the dwell time.

tokens.name: content-h
tokens.usage: THE BUDGET: 600 minus header minus rule. No scrolling, ever.

tokens.name: content-top
tokens.usage: Rule to the first card.

tokens.name: content-bottom
tokens.usage: Last card to the bottom edge.

tokens.name: card-gap
tokens.usage: Between glass cards.

tokens.name: card-pad-y
tokens.usage: Card padding, top and bottom.

tokens.name: card-pad-x
tokens.usage: Card padding, left and right. A head-to-head card is 462px wide, 396px inside.

tokens.name: card-pad-tight-y
tokens.usage: Four-stat cards, top and bottom.

tokens.name: card-pad-tight-x
tokens.usage: Four-stat cards, left and right.

tokens.name: unit-gap
tokens.usage: Number to its unit.

tokens.name: caption-gap
tokens.usage: Progress bar to its caption row.

tokens.name: bar-h
tokens.usage: Goal and progress bar thickness.

tokens.name: runner-dot
tokens.usage: The runner's colour dot beside a name label.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Glass cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Bars, tracks, chips.

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: Runner dots, training-log dots.

tokens.name: glass-inset
tokens.usage: Top-edge highlight on every glass card, combined with glass-drop.

tokens.name: glass-drop
tokens.usage: Lifts a card off the room.

tokens.name: mark-halo-a
tokens.usage: Glow around Jeffrey's lit mark (a filled bar, his dot).

tokens.name: mark-halo-b
tokens.usage: Glow around Eugenia's lit mark.

tokens.name: glass-blur
tokens.usage: Optional backdrop blur. Over a smooth haze it is nearly invisible, and it costs GPU on the Pi: measure on the panel before keeping it.

tokens.name: grain
tokens.usage: Opacity of a soft-light noise layer over the whole slide. Dithers dark gradients that would band on a 6-bit panel.

tokens.name: haze-fade
tokens.usage: Where every radial light source reaches transparent.
